title: [29.x]-"Cannot match item tracking" when partially posting an Inventory Pick for lot-tracked items with Strict Expiration Posting enabled
summary: Fixed an error that prevented partial posting of inventory picks for lot-tracked items when Strict Expiration Posting is enabled. The fix filters warehouse activity lines to only validate lots being posted, not all lot lines created by the pick split.
key_points: Partial posting of inventory picks for lot-tracked items now works correctly with Strict Expiration Posting enabled
Added a filter to exclude pick lines with zero quantity to handle from lot tracking validation
Preserves original lot-mismatch validation for lines that are actually being posted
Regression test added to prevent recurrence of this issue
